protocol.item: Severe Hypoglycaemia Is A Life-Threatening Emergency!
protocol.source_fidelity: Official HJH Emergency Department Clinical Guidelines 2026 transcription
protocol.source_text:

•
Regular small meals – can refer to Diabetic clinic/dietician for diabetic education 
•
Early symptoms of hypoglycaemia – sweating, dizziness, bad mood, trembling, palpitations, hunger.  
•
Late symptoms – confusion, visual changes, slurred speech, dizziness, seizures, lethargy, stupor, 
coma 
•
Home treatment – sugary snack, soft drink (early). Buccal honey/syrup/lollipop (late) 
Severe hypoglycaemia is a life-threatening emergency! 
Prolonged hypoglycaemia can lead to permanent brain damage! 
Correct any HGT < 4 mmol/l immediately! 
HYPOGLYCAEMIA 
 
 
 
CAUSES 
*Drugs: insulin, sulfonylureas (accidental, suicidal, iatrogenic) 
*Specific diseases: Sepsis, adrenal insufficiency, myxoedema 
coma, hepatic failure, renal failure, insulinoma, malignancy, 
gastric bypass  
*Intake/use mismatch: starvation, anorexia nervosa, extreme 
exercise, pregnancy/lactation, alcohol abuse, dysphagia from any 
cause 
 
 
ED MANAGEMENT 
If HGT is unavailable, treat empirically with dextrose 
1 – 2 ml/kg of 50% dextrose IV/IO if unable to take PO.  
NB for paediatric cases: dilute to max 25% dextrose (2 – 4 ml/kg of 25% dextrose) 
Then 5 – 10% dextrose Ringers Lactate maintenance fluid – titrate to effect, hourly HGT checks 
Oral 50% dextrose if awake AND able to swallow 
Carbohydrate rich meal once acute hypoglycaemia has been corrected if ale to swallow  
Identify and treat the UNDERLYING CAUSE or admit for HGT monitoring and further workup 
Ensure adequate PATIENT EDUCATION and safety netting for discharged patients 
Add STEROID in refractory/recurrent hypoglycaemia 
Add OCTREOTIDE in sulfonylurea overdose 
Ensure EARLY NGT FEEDS in intubated/critically ill patients 
 
CRITERIA FOR DISCHARGE 
Cause for hypoglycaemia identified and resolved 
No recurrent hypoglycaemia after carbohydrate rich meal 
Family/escort at home to monitor HGT and administer home 
treatment 
Transport to return if hypoglycaemia recurs 
Adequate patient education – see green block 
Functional HG
